meanings.en: to appear, to show up, to turn up
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'явиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'appeared', paired with 'появляться'.

examples.trans: Yes, that is me, and what do you need?

examples.text: Давай я ему скажу, что Света мне не нужна.
examples.trans: Let me tell him that I do not need Sveta.

examples.text: Тебе нужна невеста, равная нам по статусу.
examples.trans: You need a bride equal to us in status.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian clause-linking conjunction meaning 'and', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Там сейчас свежее мясо должны привезти, проконтролируй.
examples.trans: They are supposed to deliver fresh meat there right now, go check it.

examples.text: Сеня, вчера вечеринка у тебя получилась отличная.
examples.trans: Senya, your party yesterday turned out great.

examples.text: Денис, расскажи, как у тебя со Светой?
examples.trans: Denis, tell me, how are things with you and Sveta?

meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'лжен'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('must').

examples.text: Там сейчас свежее мясо должны привезти, проконтролируй.
examples.trans: They are supposed to deliver fresh meat there right now, go check it.

examples.text: Я скоро отдам всё, что тебе должен, с процентами.
examples.trans: I will soon pay back everything I owe you, with interest.

examples.text: И что он должен скорее с ней помириться.
examples.trans: And that he should make peace with her soon.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'корее').

examples.text: Ладно, пойдём скорее ко мне в кабинет.
examples.trans: Alright, let us go quickly to my office.

examples.text: Я скоро отдам всё, что тебе должен, с процентами.
examples.trans: I will soon pay back everything I owe you, with interest.

examples.text: Ребята, помогите скорее, тут во дворе дерутся!
examples.trans: Guys, help quickly, they are fighting out here in the courtyard!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'with / from', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Просто она ведёт себя так, будто мы встречаемся.
examples.trans: She just acts as if we are dating.

meanings.en: to make up, to make peace
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'мириться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to make peace, reconcile', paired with 'мириться'.

examples.text: И что он должен скорее с ней помириться.
examples.trans: And that he should make peace with her soon.

examples.text: Когда-нибудь ты захочешь помириться со своим папой.
examples.trans: Someday you will want to make up with your dad.

examples.text: Я сто раз хотела с ним помириться!
examples.trans: I wanted to make up with him a hundred times!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'where to', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Привет, Света, ты куда вчера вечером пропала?
examples.trans: Hi, Sveta, where did you disappear to last night?

examples.text: Витя, успокойся, никуда я его не втягиваю.
examples.trans: Vitya, calm down, I am not dragging him into anything.

examples.text: Никита, скажи, ну и куда мы сейчас идём?
examples.trans: Nikita, tell me, well where are we going right now?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ейчас').

examples.text: Там сейчас свежее мясо должны привезти, проконтролируй.
examples.trans: They are supposed to deliver fresh meat there right now, go check it.

examples.text: Привет, Света, с кем ты сейчас говорила?
examples.trans: Hi, Sveta, who were you talking to just now?

examples.text: Виктор, внимание, к нам сейчас едет Дягилев.
examples.trans: Viktor, attention, Dyagilev is on his way to us right now.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'are going', paired with 'пойти'.

examples.text: Ладно, мне пора идти и работать с продуктами.
examples.trans: Alright, it is time for me to go and work with the groceries.

examples.text: Поэтому извините меня, пожалуйста, мне надо идти работать.
examples.trans: So excuse me, please, I have to go work.

examples.text: Я домой идти боюсь, вдруг он караулить будет.
examples.trans: I am afraid to go home, what if he waits in ambush.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ождать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'wait', paired with 'ждать'.

examples.text: Подожди, я сейчас.
examples.trans: Wait, I'll be right there.

examples.text: Подождите минуту.
examples.trans: Wait a minute.

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

meanings.note: Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'много'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: И если честно, меня это немного напрягает.
examples.trans: And to be honest, that stresses me out a bit.

examples.text: Подожди немного, сейчас ты сама всё узнаешь.
examples.trans: Wait a little, right now you will find out everything yourself.

examples.text: Лена, я просто хочу немного брата разыграть.
examples.trans: Lena, I just want to play a little prank on my brother.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'myself', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Он сам очень заинтересовался моим новым проектом.
examples.trans: He himself became very interested in my new project.

examples.text: Подожди немного, сейчас ты сама всё узнаешь.

examples.text: Мне кажется, это Никита должен сам решать.
examples.trans: It seems to me that Nikita should decide that himself.

examples.text: Всё, Миша, пока, не звони мне больше.
examples.trans: That is it, Misha, bye, do not call me anymore.

examples.text: Я всё понял, сразу говорю, денег не дам.
examples.trans: I understood everything, I am telling you right away, I will not give you money.

examples.text: Витя, в Америке у меня всё отлично работает.
examples.trans: Vitya, in America everything works great for me.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'знать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will learn', paired with 'узнавать'.

examples.text: Подожди немного, сейчас ты сама всё узнаешь.

examples.trans: Eleonora has a grown daughter, I found out today.

examples.trans: Did you recognise me?

examples.text: Конечно понимаю, если что, я в своём номере.

познакомиться.gloss: to get acquainted, to meet (for the first time)

meanings.en: to meet for the first time, to get acquainted
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'знакомиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to get acquainted, to meet (for the first time)', paired with 'знакомиться'.

examples.trans: I dreamed of meeting your friends.
